continuity: Peng Cheolhu and two thousand Hebei Peng Family fighters have arrived to aid Shanxi; Cheolhu has interrupted Jamukha’s attack on Jin Mukyung.
Jin Mukyung remains exhausted and wounded after his confrontation with Jamukha; the battle and their confrontation remain unresolved.
The identity of the person who anticipated the Hebei Peng Family’s arrival is unknown.
The Emperor remains gravely ill with Blood Soul Gu; the treatment requiring him to die once remains unresolved.
The improved Temporary Strength Pill’s source, effects, and distribution remain unknown; Jang Sam remains unconscious after his sudden rise in level and attack on Taekyung.
The Martial God’s identity and connection to the chosen one and the Bow Saint remain unknown.
The Eastern Heaven Demon Lord’s papers and silk pouch remain unexplained.
Taekyung intends to keep the pocket watch for half a month before deciding whether to give it to Mujin.
Taekyung resolved to trust his allies rather than bear every burden alone.
plot: The Shanxi defenders seize an opening when the enemy horns sound in confusion. Peng Cheolhu leads two thousand fighters of the Hebei Peng Family into the battle, rallying them with a vow to stand by their neighbors and allies. Their charge breaks the enemy formation, and Cheolhu intervenes just as Jamukha is about to strike down the exhausted Jin Mukyung. Jamukha reveals that someone had anticipated Cheolhu’s arrival, then faces him without retreating; the battle continues.
translation_decisions: Render 투사 as “fighter” when the Shanxi warriors distinguish their identity and purpose from that of ordinary martial artists.
